endings.explain_rw: Mu Kinyarwanda, amagambo arangira n'inyajwi. Mu Cyongereza, amagambo menshi arangira n'ingombajwi. Ntukongereho inyajwi ku mpera: vuga "gud", ntuvuge "gudi".
endings.mouth_rw: Vuga ingombajwi ya nyuma, hanyuma uhite uceceka. Funga umunwa cyangwa uhagarike ururimi.

rl.explain_rw: Mu Kinyarwanda R na L byenda kumvikana kimwe. Mu Cyongereza ni amajwi abiri atandukanye, kandi ahindura igisobanuro: "rice" ni umuceri, "lice" ni inda zo mu mutwe.
rl.mouth_rw: L: isonga ry'ururimi rikora inyuma y'amenyo yo hejuru. R: ururimi ntirukora ahantu na hamwe; rusubire inyuma gato, iminwa yegerane.

ship-sheep.explain_rw: Ikinyarwanda gifite "i" imwe. Icyongereza gifite ebyiri: ingufi (ship = ubwato) n'indende (sheep = intama). Iyo uzivanze, ijambo rirahinduka.
ship-sheep.mouth_rw: "sheep": kurura ijwi, iii, umeze nk'useka. "ship": ijwi ni rigufi, umunwa uraruhutse.

th.explain_rw: Ijwi TH ntiriba mu Kinyarwanda. "think" si "sink" kandi si "tink". Hari TH ebyiri: iyoroheje (think, three) n'ifite ijwi (this, that). Iya kabiri tuyandika DH.
th.mouth_rw: Shyira isonga ry'ururimi hagati y'amenyo yo hejuru n'ayo hasi, hanyuma uhuhe umwuka. Reba mu ndorerwamo: ururimi rugomba kugaragara.

cat-cut.explain_rw: Mu Cyongereza hari amajwi abiri asa na "a" y'Ikinyarwanda. "cat" (injangwe) na "cut" (gukata) ni amagambo abiri atandukanye.
cat-cut.mouth_rw: "cat": fungura umunwa cyane, uwurambure ku mpande. "cut": umunwa ufunguye gake, ijwi rigufi rivuye mu muhogo.

clusters.explain_rw: Mu Cyongereza ingombajwi ebyiri cyangwa eshatu zishobora gukurikirana nta nyajwi iri hagati: street, small, play. Ntushyiremo inyajwi: vuga "sliip", ntuvuge "siliipu".
clusters.mouth_rw: Banza uvuge ingombajwi buhoro: s-l-iip. Hanyuma wihute kugeza zifatanye.

stress.explain_rw: Mu Cyongereza, buri jambo rigira umugemo umwe uvugwa cyane kandi utinze. Indi migemo iroroha. thirTEEN (13) na THIRty (30) bitandukanywa n'aho ushyira imbaraga. Mu nyandiko y'amajwi, umugemo ukomeye wanditse mu NYUGUTI NKURU.
stress.mouth_rw: Koma mu mashyi ku mugemo ukomeye: ba-NA-na. Indi migemo uyivuge vuba kandi mu ijwi rito.

full-fool.explain_rw: Icyongereza gifite "u" ebyiri: ingufi (full = cyuzuye) n'indende (fool = igicucu). Ni amagambo atandukanye.
full-fool.mouth_rw: "fool": iminwa isohoke imbere, ukurure ijwi: uuu. "full": iminwa iruhutse, ijwi rigufi.

he-she.explain_rw: HE (umugabo) na SHE (umugore) biratandukanye mu Cyongereza. Wumve neza itangiriro ry'ijambo: "h" cyangwa "sh".
he-she.mouth_rw: "he": umwuka gusa uvuye mu muhogo, hhh. "she": iminwa isohoke imbere, shhh, nk'ucecekesha umwana.
